# dsh-compaction-policy
中文 · Development & host tests · Security
**An experimental global compaction policy for DeepSeek Harness.** Keep the official Basic summarize
r, checkpoint records, tool pairing, token meter, UI event protocol, native `/compact`, and overflow
recovery. Change proactive budgeting, range selection, and no-progress retries—without selecting a
ge proactive budgeting, range selection, and no-progress retries—without selecting a special preset.
**Experimental v0.2.3.** Ported to the DSH **0.2.2-rc.1** host generation. The bundle load-admits th
e DSH **`^0.2.2-rc.1`** host line (0.2.x from that build on, including later release candidates) and
Cordis **`4.0.x` / `4.1.x`**; the policy then *activates* only when seven Basic method fingerprints
match the verified implementation. A host bump that changes only version labels needs no plugin upd
ate, and an unrecognized host build leaves the plugin loaded but inert on stock Basic instead of fai
ling startup. Actual-host tests with synthetic sessions and scripted model responses have passed. **
This is not proof of live GUI behavior or summary quality on a native Windows/real-model session.**
No lossless-summary or larger-context-window claim is made.
> **Running DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 – 0.2.1-rc.5?** Stay on v0.2.2. The 0.2.2 generation moved pressure logic
into `compactPressure` and added a model-switch check. Alpha.2/alpha.3 already contain that impleme
ntation, but ship unverified Cordis prereleases; this port deliberately starts at the tested 0.2.2-r
but ship unverified Cordis prereleases; this port deliberately starts at the tested 0.2.2-rc.1 host.
## What installation changes
The default bundle installs exactly **one root plugin**:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- **Global policy:** covers eligible existing and future official Basic instances in the **same Cord
is runtime**, including ordinary presets. It uses Basic's native pressure mechanism, adds no compact
ion engine or automatic compaction listener, and does not switch presets. Exactly one host method is
patched, Basic's `compactPressure`, which both automatic checks pass through: the between-step pres
sure check and (DSH 0.2.2+) the check before switching to another model. Manual `/compact` and confi

rmed-overflow recovery never reach it and stay entirely native.
- **No special preset:** the package

registers no preset and does not filter the preset registry. Continue using your normal presets.
-
Your **current default provider and preset stay unchanged**. Main-request output limits, reasoning e
ffort, provider/model selection, and token accounting are not rewritten.
Only the fingerprint-verified official Basic implementation is targeted. Custom backends, subclasses
, and instances with method overrides are skipped. Presets with no compaction, including minimal com
positions without it, are unaffected. “Global” does not mean every DSH process or profile on the mac
ions without it, are unaffected. “Global” does not mean every DSH process or profile on the machine.
## Default policy: 90%, with no double deduction
Stock Basic can trigger early when a model permits a large output:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Defaults are **`thresholdRatio: 0.9`, `outputReserveCap: 0`, `headroomTokens: 0`**, so the proactive
threshold is exactly **`floor(W × 0.9)`**. The remaining 10% is the margin; it is **not deducted a
second time**. For a 262,144-token window with a 131,072-token output cap, the threshold changes fro
m 65,536 to **235,929 tokens**. This is arithmetic, not a performance benchmark.
**`pruneToolResults: false` applies only to the new proactive path** (the background check and the m
odel-switch check). That path does not pre-prune tool results; old content is summarized through Bas
ic. It does not disable the native pruner service or change stock-mode, manual, or confirmed-overflo
not disable the native pruner service or change stock-mode, manual, or confirmed-overflow behavior.
> **An output cap is not guaranteed available space.** A 90%-full prompt and a full 128K completion
cannot coexist in a 256K window. The adapter/server must enforce remaining capacity; providers that
validate `input + max_tokens` may reject earlier. Native overflow recovery still applies. This plugi
n is not an HTTP output-budget clamp.
### Selection and failure guard
- Retain recent history with a **soft target of 16%**. Whole messages and tool-call/result units sta

y atomic; the newest unit remains verbatim even when larger than the target.
- Allow an older large
message into the summary rather than repeatedly summarizing only a tiny preceding checkpoint. System

nodes are protected; a later system node is a selection barrier.
- Require at least **2,048 non-che

ckpoint tokens** in the selected range before proactive summarization.
- Make at most **one summary

transaction per pressure step**; do not immediately summarize the fresh checkpoint again.
- Back off
failures for **60s, 120s, 240s… up to 10 minutes**. Expiry allows one probe on the next pressure ch
eck, not a background model call. Material candidate changes may permit earlier retry; unrelated tai

l appends do not.
- Preserve native manual and confirmed-overflow paths, retry limits, transaction c
ompletion, and durable-progress checks. They bypass the proactive guard.
### Model switches (DSH 0.2.2+)
Since DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, Basic also checks the history before a request moves to a different provider/m
odel, pricing the **proposed** envelope against the **target** route's window and refusing the switc
h if compaction cannot bring it under the threshold. Left alone, that check would compact at the sto
ck threshold (41% of a 1,000,000-token window for a route that declares a 524,288-token output cap)
no matter what this plugin does for ordinary steps. Under the policy:
- The target route's **policy threshold** decides whether anything runs: switching between 1M-class
models at 60% of the window compacts nothing; switching to a 100K-window route at 95K tokens compact

s first.
- When compaction is needed, it uses the same selection and the **same attempt budget as na
tive Basic** (`compactionRetries + 1`), judged against the policy threshold. If it cannot end below
the threshold, the switch is **refused with the host's own error** (`MODEL_SWITCH_COMPACTION_FAILED`

), exactly like stock.
- A switch is a deliberate action: it is never held back by the background re
try cooldown and its failures never start one. If another background check is running for the sessio

n, the switch waits for it and then evaluates itself.
